result.name: contacts_list_addressbooks
result.description: List your own and shared address books plus, when the admin exposes it, the read-only accounts catalog of the instance.

result.name: contacts_search_contacts
result.description: Search contacts by name, email, phone or organization in one address book or, when "addressbook" is omitted, in all of them including the read-only accounts of the instance (colleagues). Account results carry accountId, the user ID to use for invitations, attendees, Deck and Talk. An empty query lists personal contacts only; accounts need a search term of at least 2 characters.

addressbook.description: Address book path returned by List address books. Omit to search all of them.

offset.description: Offset among matching results; use nextOffset to continue.

result.name: contacts_read_contact
result.description: Read a contact including all vCard properties and its ETag. A contact of the accounts catalog returns only its public fields and accountId, without vCard or ETag.

addressbook.description: Address book path returned by List address books.

uri.description: Contact object URI returned by Search contacts.

result.name: contacts_create_contact
result.description: Create a contact in a writable personal or shared address book. The plan_state of the plan carries the contact UID that confirmation stores; send it back with confirm=true. Returns a detailed plan without writing. Show it to the user, wait for explicit approval, then repeat with confirm=true and the optional etag from the plan. Shared collections also require confirm_shared=true.

addressbook.description: Address book path returned by List address books.

plan_state.description: Opaque value of the plan. Send it back unchanged together with confirm: true. If the state changed since the plan, nothing is written and the answer is the new plan.

name.description: Contact name. Omit to preserve its existing value.

organization.description: Organization company name (first ORG component); existing departments and units are preserved.

title.description: Contact title. Omit to preserve its existing value.

note.description: Contact note. Omit to preserve its existing value.

url.description: Contact url. Omit to preserve its existing value.

emails.description: Replace the emails in order; existing parameters are preserved. Omit to keep all values, [] to clear them.

phones.description: Replace the phones in order; existing parameters are preserved. Omit to keep all values, [] to clear them.

confirm_shared.description: Acknowledge changing a collection owned by another person after showing the shared notice.

result.name: contacts_edit_contact
result.description: Edit only supplied contact fields, preserving unknown vCard properties. Returns a detailed plan without writing. Show it to the user, wait for explicit approval, then repeat with confirm=true and the optional etag from the plan. Shared collections also require confirm_shared=true.

addressbook.description: Address book path returned by List address books.

uri.description: Contact object URI returned by Search contacts.

etag.description: expected etag; if it differs, nothing is changed

name.description: Contact name. Omit to preserve its existing value.

organization.description: Organization company name (first ORG component); existing departments and units are preserved.

title.description: Contact title. Omit to preserve its existing value.

note.description: Contact note. Omit to preserve its existing value.

url.description: Contact url. Omit to preserve its existing value.

emails.description: Replace the emails in order; existing parameters are preserved. Omit to keep all values, [] to clear them.

phones.description: Replace the phones in order; existing parameters are preserved. Omit to keep all values, [] to clear them.

confirm_shared.description: Acknowledge changing a collection owned by another person after showing the shared notice.

result.name: contacts_delete_contact
result.description: Permanently delete a contact after saving a verified vCard backup in your Files. Nextcloud has no contact trash. Returns a detailed plan without writing. Show it to the user, wait for explicit approval, then repeat with confirm=true and the optional etag from the plan. Shared collections also require confirm_shared=true.

addressbook.description: Address book path returned by List address books.

uri.description: Contact object URI returned by Search contacts.

etag.description: expected etag; if it differs, nothing is changed
